title.text: A leap year that is too simple

runs.text: This program gets 2024 and 2023 right. Find a year it gets wrong.

hints.text: Look at the decision table in the lesson. Which columns does this program not test?
The program asks a single question. Which part of the rule is missing?
Look for a year that divides by 4 and also by 100, but not by 400.
and it is not. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Is there a year this program marks as not a leap year that actually is one? (No: every leap year divides by 4.)
The years that divide by 100 and not by 400 break the program: 1900, 2100, 2200. 2000 does not break it, because the program gets it right by chance.
